column1: I  ……  of  ……  do  hereby  state  that  the  said  ……  ……  (name  of
person  missing)  …………  has  been  missing  for  a  period  of  over  one
year,  and  I  verily  believe    that  the  said  …………  is  dead.
I  therefore  request  that  the  death  be  registered  under  the  Births  and
Deaths  Registration Act  (Chapter  110)  and  a  Certificate  of  Death  in
respect  of  such  death  be  issued  to  me.
